Class OrderingTrendsPage

java.lang.Object
Manager.Page
OrderingTrendsPage
public class OrderingTrendsPage extends Manager.Page
Manager page with sales reports for a date range, including order count, revenue, average order value, a chart of orders over time, and sales of individual menu items, filtered by drink category. Also provides access to today's X-report.

    private static final class

    Generates today's X-report, which summarizes hourly sales activity, daily transaction totals, and sales grouped by payment method.

    • loadCategories

      private void loadCategories()
      Loads every distinct drink category from the database into the category filter, after the "All" option.

      Displays a database error message if the query fails.

    • updateTrends

      private void updateTrends()
      Recalculates and displays the statistic cards, sales-by-item table, and orders chart for the selected date range and filters.

      If the date range is invalid, leaves the current report unchanged. If the summary query fails, displays a database error and stops updating the remaining report components.

    • loadSalesByItem

      private void loadSalesByItem(Manager.DateRangeBar.DateRange range, String category)
      Lists every menu item sold in the selected date range, including its quantity sold and sales revenue, ordered by quantity sold and then sales.

      If a category is supplied, includes only items in that category. Updates the sales status message after loading the results. If the query fails, displays an error message in the sales report card.

      Parameters:
      range - the date range used to filter sales
      category - the category to include, or null to include all categories

    • loadChartData

      private void loadChartData(Manager.DateRangeBar.DateRange range, String category)
      Loads order counts grouped by day, week, or month according to the selected grouping filter, then updates the chart with the resulting data.

      If a category is supplied, counts only orders containing items in that category. If the query fails, clears the chart data.

      Parameters:
      range - the date range used to filter orders
      category - the category to include, or null to include all categories

    • setRangeAndCategory

      private static void setRangeAndCategory(PreparedStatement statement, Manager.DateRangeBar.DateRange range, String category) throws SQLException
      Sets the date range and optional category parameters on a prepared statement.

      The start timestamp is inclusive and the end timestamp is exclusive. If the category is not null, it is assigned as the third parameter.

      Parameters:
      statement - the prepared statement to configure
      range - the date range to apply
      category - the category to filter by, or null for all categories
      Throws:
      SQLException - if setting any statement parameter fails
